title: feat: open any model directly in Play via /play?model=<id>
author: xiaotian1171
pr_body_excerpt:
Closes #13903

## Changes
- Adds a compact **Try in Play** action for model types supported by Play.
- Opens the shared public `/play?model=<model-id>` URL.
- Preselects the requested model and shows its Image, Text, Audio, or Video category.
- Keeps the change frontend-only and reuses existing model-category logic.

Includes the simpler category-selection behavior from #13920 by @davealan74.

gist.headline: Every model gets a playground
gist.blurb: Model listings now carry a small shortcut to Play. Pick a model, open the link, and it arrives already sitting in the right kind of sandbox.
gist.summary: Added a compact Try in Play action to supported model rows that opens the public `/play?model=<model-id>` URL, preselecting the model and its Image, Text, Audio, or Video category.
gist.impact: People browsing models can now jump directly from a model listing into a correctly configured Play session instead of selecting the model and category again.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli guiding a set of small labeled model seeds from a model catalog into a cozy shared playground, where four gentle stations represent Image, Text, Audio, and Video. A retro monitor shows the simple route `/play?model=...`, while code-plants and flowers make the shortcut feel like a well-marked garden path.
